### Root Cause (1 issue)

**`Services/Services.csproj` is missing a `PackageReference` to `Newtonsoft.Json`**

The file `Services/UserService.cs` uses:
```csharp
using Newtonsoft.Json;          // line 2
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;     // line 3
// ... 
new JObject(...)                // line 22
```

But the `Services.csproj` does not declare a `<PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" />`. The restore completed with no packages for this project (no Newtonsoft.Json.dll was passed to `csc`).

### Cascading Failure

**`Api.csproj`** failed at `ResolveProjectReferences` because it has a `<ProjectReference>` to `../Services/Services.csproj`, which failed to build. This is **not** an independent error.

### Fix

Add the missing NuGet package reference to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

This single fix resolves all 3 compiler errors in Services and unblocks the Api project build.
